data.body: AC amendment: Each test function must clean up its own temp directories using `trap 'rm -rf ${CLEANUP_DIRS[@]:-}' EXIT` or equivalent. The concurrent test (`test_write_cycle_ledger_concurrent_safe`) must use `wait` before asserting on the output file to avoid race conditions in the test harness itself. Verify: grep -q 'trap.*rm.*EXIT\|CLEANUP_DIRS' $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/tests/scripts/test-write-cycle-ledger.sh
